name: MV-Adapter (Multiview)
description: Generates 6 orthographic reference views from a single input image using MV-Adapter I2MV-SD2.1 at 512x512 (the low-VRAM variant, recommended for <6GB GPUs). Outputs front, front-left, left, back, right, front-right views plus a 2x2 grid of the 4 cardinal views in reading order [front, left, back, right] to feed the mesh-generation step. Post-processing keeps views consistent: the real (centered) reference replaces the model's drifting front, and every view is recentered to a uniform subject scale. The grid feeds both mesh generation and multi-reference/hybrid texturing.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Lower resolution reduces VRAM and speeds up generation.

params_schema.label: Remove Background
params_schema.tooltip: Remove background from the reference image before generating views.

params_schema.label: Reference As Front
params_schema.tooltip: Use the (background-removed, centered) input photo itself as the front view instead of the model's regenerated front. Eliminates front-view scale/angle drift and lets downstream hybrid texturing bake the real photo pixels with no stretching. Recommended for both mesh generation and texturing.

params_schema.label: Normalize View Framing
params_schema.tooltip: Recenter each generated view and scale its subject to fill 90% of the frame on a uniform gray background. Fixes the per-view scale/position drift that causes bake seams and warping strain downstream.
